use_cases.name: Request travel, claim expenses and settle the advance
use_cases.goal: Let an employee request business travel with an advance, claim expenses against policy limits with receipt capture, and have the claim approved, settled and posted to the ERP system.

stakeholders.interest: Is reimbursed quickly and correctly, with the advance netted off automatically.
Approves only business-justified travel and sees policy deviations named.
Receives balanced, cost-centre-coded postings and clears advances on time.
Can trace every reimbursement to receipts, approvals and the ERP document.

use_cases.trigger: An employee plans a business trip, for example a 3-day process audit from the Pune office to Medchal Works.
preconditions: Travel and expense policy limits are configured by grade and city class.
Expense categories are mapped to GL accounts and cost centres.
The employee has an active assignment with a cost centre.
postconditions_success: The claim is settled against the advance, the net amount is paid or recovered, and the journal is posted to the ERP system with a document number.
postconditions_failure: Claims rejected or returned keep their history and no payment or posting occurs.
Unsettled advances older than the policy limit are flagged to Finance.

main_flow.action: Raises a travel request for 2026-11-17 to 2026-11-19 to Medchal Works, with purpose, cost centre and an advance of ₹15,000.
Checks the estimate against grade limits for hotel, per diem and travel class and highlights any deviation.
Approves the request through the approval engine; the advance is queued for Finance payment.
After the trip, photographs receipts in the mobile app.
Extracts vendor, date, amount and tax details from each receipt as a draft line for the employee to check.
Corrects and confirms each line and submits the claim of ₹21,400.
Checks each line against policy limits, duplicate receipts and travel dates, and flags exceptions with the limit breached.
Approves the claim; lines over limit need a stated justification before approval.
Audits flagged lines and approves; the platform nets the ₹15,000 advance and schedules ₹6,400 for reimbursement.
Builds the expense journal by GL and cost centre and posts it to the ERP system, storing the returned document number.

alternate_flows.condition: The claim is less than the advance.
steps: The employee repays it, or it is raised as a payroll recovery in the next open run after the employee confirms.

alternate_flows.condition: The tenant reimburses expenses through payroll.
steps: Platform raises a non-taxable reimbursement payroll input for the net amount.

exception_flows.condition: The same receipt has been claimed before.
exception_flows.handling: The line is blocked and both claims are shown.

exception_flows.condition: An expense category has no GL mapping.
exception_flows.handling: The journal is blocked and the message names the category.

exception_flows.condition: The ERP system rejects the posting or times out.
exception_flows.handling: The failure is shown and the retry reuses the same journal ID so no duplicate is created.
The claim batch is not marked posted and is flagged for Finance.

nfrs: Receipt extraction returns a draft within 5 s per receipt; nothing is submitted without employee confirmation.
Receipt images are retained for the period configured in the finance retention policy.

user_stories.want: to photograph receipts and have the lines filled for me to check
user_stories.so_that: I can claim in minutes instead of typing every bill

acceptance.given: E1018 photographs a Medchal hotel bill for ₹9,600 for two nights
acceptance.then: a draft line shows vendor, dates and ₹9,600 for her to confirm, and nothing is submitted until she does
the line is saved with ₹9,450 and the correction is recorded

user_stories.want: policy deviations named on the claim I approve
user_stories.so_that: I can decide with the facts in front of me

acceptance.given: the grade limit for a city-class B hotel is ₹4,500 per night
acceptance.then: the line shows Over limit by ₹300 per night and needs a justification
approval is blocked until the employee adds one

user_stories.want: advances netted and the journal posted with an ERP document number
user_stories.so_that: advances are cleared and the books match

acceptance.given: an advance of ₹15,000 and an approved claim of ₹21,400
acceptance.then: ₹6,400 is scheduled for reimbursement and the advance shows settled
the claim batch shows posted with that document number

use_cases.name: Account for employer statutory contributions, benefit costs and liabilities
use_cases.goal: Post employer statutory contributions, benefit costs and related liabilities to the general ledger with period-end accruals, reversals and clearing on payment.

stakeholders.interest: Books the full employer cost of people in the right period and cost centre.
Sees liabilities cleared when statutory payments are made.
Can drill from each GL line to the payroll lines and payments behind it.

use_cases.trigger: A payroll run reaches APPROVED, a statutory payment is recorded, or the accounting period closes.
preconditions: Employer contribution components (PF and pension, ESIC, labour welfare fund, group insurance premium, gratuity and leave encashment provisions) are mapped to expense and liability GL accounts.
Accrual and reversal method is configured per component.
The ERP system accepts journals for the entity and period.
postconditions_success: Expense and liability journals are posted with document numbers, and liability balances reconcile to statutory payments.
postconditions_failure: Unmapped or unbalanced journals are blocked and the period stays open.

main_flow.action: Derives employer contributions and benefit costs from the approved November 2026 run for both legal entities.
Validates that every component has both an expense and a liability mapping by cost centre.
Builds the cost journal debiting expense by cost centre and crediting statutory and benefit liabilities.
Reviews the journal summary by entity, site and component and approves it.
Posts the journal to the ERP system and stores the returned document number.
At period close, posts accruals for costs incurred but not yet in a run, such as provisions for the last week of attendance.
Reverses the accruals on day 1 of the next period as configured.
Records the statutory payment reference when the contribution is paid.
Posts the clearing journal debiting the liability and crediting the bank clearing account.
Reconciles each liability balance to statutory payments and shows the result to Finance.

alternate_flows.condition: The tenant uses gratuity and leave encashment valuations rather than monthly provisions.
steps: Finance uploads the actuarial valuation figure.
Platform posts the difference from the booked liability as a true-up journal.

exception_flows.condition: A component has no GL mapping.
exception_flows.handling: The journal is blocked and the message names the component.

exception_flows.condition: A provision is mapped with a debit leg only.
exception_flows.handling: Validation fails and names the missing credit leg.

exception_flows.condition: The ERP system rejects the posting.
exception_flows.handling: The failure is shown and the retry reuses the journal ID.

exception_flows.condition: The liability does not reconcile to the payment.
exception_flows.handling: The check shows Fail with expected, actual and variance and the period stays open.

exception_flows.condition: A GL line cannot be drilled to payslip lines.
exception_flows.handling: It is treated as a failed drill-through assertion and flagged.

nfrs: Debits equal credits for every journal before posting.
Journals for a 3,000-employee run are built within 60 s.

user_stories.want: employer contributions posted by cost centre as soon as the run is approved
user_stories.so_that: I see the true monthly people cost

acceptance.given: the November 2026 run for Vindhya Precision Industries Pvt Ltd is approved with employer PF of ₹38,40,000
acceptance.then: PF expense is debited by cost centre and the PF liability is credited ₹38,40,000

acceptance.given: the labour welfare fund component has no liability mapping
acceptance.then: it is blocked and names the component
a reversal of ₹4,20,000 is posted dated 2026-12-01

acceptance.given: the reversal fails at the ERP system
acceptance.then: a retry with the same journal ID posts once

user_stories.want: the liability cleared when I record the statutory payment
user_stories.so_that: the balance shows what is still owed

acceptance.given: the PF liability is ₹38,40,000 and I record a payment of ₹38,40,000
acceptance.then: the reconciliation shows Pass with nil variance
it shows Fail with variance ₹30,000 and the period stays open
